# FR13_COMMIT_ARGMAX_GATE — in-process committer-row argmax gate (CPU implementation complete)

## 1) Fresh coord table (re-grepped on HEAD `00763f89`, `scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py`)

The committer is a **token-id selector, not a logit selector** — it indexes pre-computed argmax arrays. This is the decisive structural fact for splitting channel-1 vs channel-2.

| element | location (HEAD, after my edits) | role |
|---|---|---|
| greedy committer fn | `_lumo_tree_path_lcp_max_greedy_sample` def @ **L5421** (was 5330) | builds `row` = served tokens per request |
| committer call site | patched `sample` body, `output_token_ids = rejection_sample(...)` @ **L7188** (r-string `stock_call_new`, anchored on `"FR10 sampled tree committer disengaged"`) | passes token-id arrays into committer |
| verify logits computed | **L6858** `tree_self_logits = logits[metadata.tree_self_logits_indices]`; **L6841** `target_logits = apply_sampling_constraints(...)` | the two raw verify-forward dists |
| argmax → token ids | **L6887** `target_logits.argmax` → `parent_token_ids`; **L6889** `lumo_tree_self_logits.argmax` → `self_token_ids` | the committer's inputs are argmaxes-by-construction |
| served-row build | **L5680-5706** (`row` = accepted `drafts[node]` + one bonus via `bonus_source`) | each pos maps to a flat verify-logit row |
| row-index identity | `target_logits` / `tree_self_logits` are indexed by **flat node** `start + node` (confirmed by the gather loop @ L6960-7000: `target_logits_index`/`self_logits_index` per node) | class-5 row convention |
| `num_accepted`/node-paths metadata | `accepted_lens`/`accepted_node_paths` @ **L5710-5713**; published globals `_LUMO_TREE_LAST_ACCEPTED_*_KERNEL` @ **L5726+** | seam-naming |

**Key finding:** the committer's *bonus* token at a full-accept boundary is `self_targets[leaf] = argmax(tree_self_logits[start+leaf])`; at a reject boundary it is `parent_targets[reject_node] = argmax(target_logits[start+reject_node])`. So channel-1 is **trivially satisfied iff the committer indexed the correct flat row** — a channel-1 mismatch (`committed != argmax(verify_logits[row_used])`) means the committer used the **wrong row** (the legacy `path0_native_bonus` last-forward-row case, or any off-by-one). The 168x gold-gate flip is therefore *either* a wrong-row commit (channel-1) *or* the verify forward itself flipped the argmax (channel-2).

## 2) Capture schema + field provenance (jsonl, one record per served token)

Written by the committer per `pos` in `row` (`scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py`, the gate block inserted after `row = row[:int(max_spec_len)+1]` @ **L5707+**):

| field | source (file:line) |
|---|---|
| `step` | call-site `_FR13_CAG_STEP` counter @ L7166 |
| `req_index`, `served_pos` | committer loop `req_i` / `enumerate(row)` |
| `committed_token_id` | `row[pos]` (the literal served token) |
| `num_accepted_this_step` | `best_lcp` @ L5677 |
| `node_id`, `node_type` | `best_path[pos]`; spine/leaf via first-child chain recompute; bonus → `reject_correction`/`root_correction`/`bonus_self_{spine,leaf}`/`bonus_native_lastrow` |
| `accept_run_index` | `pos` for accepted prefix; `-1` for bonus |
| `bonus_source` | committer's `bonus_source` @ L5685-5705 |
| `logit_kind` | `'target'` (parent-edge dist) / `'self'` (node dist) / `None` (native-bonus = no per-node row) |
| `committed_row` | flat row `start + node` the committer indexed |
| **CH-1** `verify_argmax_id`, `verify_argmax_logit`, `committed_token_logit`, `ch1_margin`, `ch1_match` | `_fr13_commit_argmax_gate_row_stats(_cag_src[_cag_flat])` over the **published raw logit tensor at the row the committer used** |
| **CH-2** `verify_runnerup_id`, `verify_runnerup_logit`, `verify_top2_margin` | top-2 of that same verify row |
| `best_path`, `spine_path_idx`, `winner_path_idx`, `row_known`, `oob` | committer locals / publish bounds |

## 3) Flag wiring proof

- Patcher: `_FR13_COMMIT_ARGMAX_GATE = environ.get('FR13_COMMIT_ARGMAX_GATE','0')=='1'` (helper module scope); 25 occurrences; **zero** default-ON reads.
- Call site (`stock_call_new`): ON publishes `_FR13_CAG_TARGET_LOGITS`/`_FR13_CAG_SELF_LOGITS`/`_FR13_CAG_NUM_DRAFT`/`_FR13_CAG_STEP`; **OFF sets both logit globals to None** → committer `_fr13_cag_active=False` → capture block fully skipped (verbatim-legacy, no value touched).
- Needle both states: `_fr13_commit_argmax_gate_needle(_fr13_cag_active)` fires once, `armed=0 (inert)` / `armed=1 (armed-eager-only)`, **outside** the gate.
- Launcher `scripts/fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh`: `FR13_COMMIT_ARGMAX_GATE=${...:-0}` + `_DUMP` default @ L71-72; docker `-e` passthrough @ L229-230; "NEVER bind =1 into a serving config" discipline written next to flag.
- EAGER-safe: `_fr13_commit_argmax_gate_row_stats` fail-louds via `is_current_stream_capturing()` **before** `topk`/`.item()` (class 6).

## 4) Channel-1-vs-channel-2 capture design

- **Channel 1 (committer row-mapping, in-process, confound-free):** `ch1_match = (committed_token_id == argmax(verify_logits[committed_row]))` where `committed_row` is the *exact* flat row the committer indexed. `ch1_margin > 0` ⇒ committer served a non-argmax for that row → a **wrong-row bug**; `node_type`+`bonus_source`+`accept_run_index`+`num_accepted` name the seam (e.g. `bonus_native_lastrow` = the legacy last-forward-row case; `bonus_self_leaf` = FIX-A self/leaf handling; `reject_correction` = conv-fusion committed-path row at `num_accepted>1`).
- **Channel 2 (verify-forward losslessness):** `verify_argmax_id` + `verify_top2_margin` are recorded so the **reduce** compares them against a **clean teacher-forced single-forward** at the same byte-identical prefix. If `ch1_match` is True (committer correct) but `verify_argmax_id != clean_argmax` at clear `verify_top2_margin`, the divergence is in the verify forward (TREE_ATTN/fp8/conv-fusion), not the committer. A cheap in-process clean reference isn't available here (would need a second forward), so the reduce teacher-forces — exactly as the close workflow validated.

## 5) Checks (all green)

- New wiring test `tests/test_fr13_commit_argmax_gate_wiring.py`: **12 passed** (flag default-OFF, launcher passthrough, needle both-states, call-site arm-only-publish, eager-only-fail-loud-before-sync, CH-1/CH-2/seam fields, all-bonus-sources row map, fragment parse, **patch-applies-to-pristine-0.19 + py_compile**).
- `py_compile` patcher: OK. `bash -n` launcher: OK. Helper r-string + `stock_call_new` fragments compile.
- Adjacent suites seeded for the new committer module-globals (OFF + no-op needle, the established EAGER_PACK pattern) in `test_fr13_s1_bonus_row.py`, `test_fr13_conv_committed_path.py` (3 namespaces), `test_fr13_nondet_chase_fixes.py`.
- Full FR13 suite: **453 passed, 24 skipped** (skips are GPU/pristine-gated; the 5 collection errors — `test_cli`/`test_data_pool`/etc. — are pre-existing `lumo_flywheel_serving` host-import failures, untouched by this change).

## How to run the diagnostic
Eager boot of the tree server with `FR13_COMMIT_ARGMAX_GATE=1` (+ `ENFORCE_EAGER`/eager flag), serve the pinned probes `output/fr13_acceptance_ladder/prompts_swe4.json` at greedy seed 1313; read `/logs/fr13_commit_argmax_gate.jsonl`. First record with `ch1_match=false` at clear `ch1_margin` = a committer row bug (seam named by metadata); if `ch1_match` holds everywhere but the served stream still flips (p2/p3), the reduce's channel-2 teacher-force localizes it to the verify forward.

Files changed (all under `/home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel`):

- `scripts/fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh` (flag default + dump + `-e` passthrough)
- `tests/test_fr13_commit_argmax_gate_wiring.py` (new)
- `tests/test_fr13_s1_bonus_row.py`, `tests/test_fr13_conv_committed_path.py`, `tests/test_fr13_nondet_chase_fixes.py` (namespace seeds; no value change)
